text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 470 workers of Mozambique's largest milling and food processing company, the Companhia Industrial da Matola, near Maputo have decided to suspend a strike they began on Wednesday.

- The Portuguese agro-industrial group Joao Ferreira dos Santos, which has been operating in Mozambique for a century, has expressed an interest in buying US$60 million worth of the Mozambican state's debt to Portugal.
- Mozambique's parliament ended a one-month special session on Thursday by approving government bills on defence and security, the environment, land law and electricity policy.
